src: 'The First Dark pulls itself into the shape of a wolf — too many legs, too many teeth. (Fire and steel could find its edges.)'

src: 'The First Dark becomes a winter: long, white and silent. (Fire and lightning could crack it.)'

src: 'The First Dark wears the shape of a sun. It is the wrong color. (Light feeds it now — shadow and ice will cut.)'

src: '"...Form up. FORM UP." Bones rise from the rubble to answer.'

src: 'The Knight lifts its greatsword high. Behind it, a thousand faint soldiers lift theirs. (Guard!)'

src: 'The Sovereign calls her court. A hoarlight drifts down from the ceiling.'

src: 'The Sovereign sheds her crown of ice! Underneath, she is all wind and old snow. (Lightning no longer bites — try wind.)'

k: "MY COURT. ATTEND ME."
src: '"MY COURT. ATTEND ME."'

src: 'The air goes still. Frost crawls up your boots, your knees, your breath... (Absolute Zero is coming.)'

k: "...hush." The Dark Before.
src: '"...hush." The Dark Before.'

k: "...you have so many shapes. let me try one on."
src: '"...you have so many shapes. let me try one on."'

k: "...i will unmake you gently. the way a tide unmakes a footprint." Pieces of before break away and drift toward you.
src: '"...i will unmake you gently. the way a tide unmakes a footprint." Pieces of before break away and drift toward you.'

k: More of it breaks loose. It is coming apart to reach you.
src: 'More of it breaks loose. It is coming apart to reach you.'

k: "...it was so quiet, before you. i was never lonely. i did not even have the word."
src: '"...it was so quiet, before you. i was never lonely. i did not even have the word."'

src: 'Everything goes white. The First Dark draws in all the light there is. (Guard. Shell. Now.)'

src: 'The First Dark breathes in. The light in the room leans toward it... (Brace — the Dark Before is coming.)'

k: "...a HUNDRED! Ready or not, here I come!"
src: '"...a HUNDRED! Ready or not, here I come!"'

k: "Twenty... twenty-one... no peeking!"
src: '"Twenty... twenty-one... no peeking!"'

k: "Fifty-five... fifty-six... I can hear you breathing!"
src: '"Fifty-five... fifty-six... I can hear you breathing!"'

k: "Ninety-eight... ninety-nine..."
src: '"Ninety-eight... ninety-nine..."'

k: "I'm tired. Is the game over? ...Did I win?"
src: '"I\'m tired. Is the game over? ...Did I win?"'

k: Lysa covers her eyes. "One... two... three..." (She is counting to a hundred. Get ready.)
src: 'Lysa covers her eyes. "One... two... three..." (She is counting to a hundred. Get ready.)'

k: "Don't go home yet. Please? Everyone always goes home."
src: '"Don\'t go home yet. Please? Everyone always goes home."'

k: "Lanterns! Come play!" Paper lanterns from the festival drift down around her.
src: '"Lanterns! Come play!" Paper lanterns from the festival drift down around her.'

k: Lysa giggles and ducks behind a lantern. (Hidden: blades will miss. Spells will not.)
src: 'Lysa giggles and ducks behind a lantern. (Hidden: blades will miss. Spells will not.)'

k: The Hound howls. The shadows of its shadows answer.
src: 'The Hound howls. The shadows of its shadows answer.'

src: 'Brinefang drinks the whole remembered sea... (A wave is coming.)'

k: "HAYMAKER!"
src: '"HAYMAKER!"'

k: "All forty of you — GET THEM!"
src: '"All forty of you — GET THEM!"'

k: "Rise, child. Your suffering is not over yet."
src: '"Rise, child. Your suffering is not over yet."'

src: 'Sister Mercy folds her hands. "Hush now..." The whole arena goes quiet. (A hymn is coming.)'

src: 'The Glasswyrm dives into the sand. The arena floor begins to hum. (Brace yourselves.)'

src: 'The mask cracks. Behind it there is no one at all.'

src: 'The Penitent kneels and lowers its head, as if in prayer. (It is not praying.)'

k: "Stay. Stay exactly as you are."
src: '"Stay. Stay exactly as you are."'

src: 'The Noon King raises one hand. It becomes very, very bright. (High Noon is coming.)'

k: "Why did you leave the island? Why did you give him the stone? Why, why, why—"
src: '"Why did you leave the island? Why did you give him the stone? Why, why, why—"'

k: "Don't worry about me. Nobody ever does. That's fine. That's FINE."
src: '"Don\'t worry about me. Nobody ever does. That\'s fine. That\'s FINE."'

k: "I can't move. I can't move. Sir Aldous, I can't—"
src: '"I can\'t move. I can\'t move. Sir Aldous, I can\'t—"'

k: "Which name is mine? Tell me which name is mine."
src: '"Which name is mine? Tell me which name is mine."'
